fields.title: 4. Items Touching Milestones and Disruptive Variables
fields.md:
- **D-2030-1 (top-5 concentration ≤75%)**: 66% (2026-06-30) → 65% (2026-09-30; top 5 = Alphabet, American Express, Apple, Bank of America, Coca-Cola; source: [10-Q R14](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R14.htm)). Reproduced from the 13F: top-5 total $217.63 billion (formula 75,901.2 + 46,104.8 + 36,374.7 + 34,432.0 + 24,812.5) ÷ 10-Q equity fair value $335.515 billion = 64.9% (formula). Using the 13F total as the denominator gives 71.5% (formula 217,625 ÷ 304,197) — **definition difference**: the milestone is judged on the 10-Q definition (including non-US equities). Status remains in progress.
- **D-2027-1 (2027 annual net purchases)**: Before the judgment year — the 13F does not change the 9M 2026 reference figure of +$11.2 billion (source: [3Q26 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/brka-20260930.htm)).
- **D4 (AI infrastructure capital intensification)**: Among positions increased in 3Q, none are data center, power or AI infrastructure names — Alphabet is unchanged (source: [3Q information table](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463399/60471.xml)). No status change.
- **D5 (buying opportunity in a 'casino market')**: 3Q was not a phase of −20% from the S&P 500 peak (judgment), and net sales were $0.43 billion — R6 not satisfied (source: state.probability_adjustment_rules R6).
- **T5 (Bending Spoons additional stake)**: The 13F lists 20,689,655 shares and $689.4 million at end of 3Q for the first time (not in the 2Q 13F; source: both information tables). The 13F has no ownership percentage or settlement date, so it cannot be distinguished whether this is 'settlement of the additional stake (about 4%)' — T5 remains pending, with the 4Q26 10-K equity note and press reports as the verification path (judgment).
